abstract_evidence_excerpt: The biodegradability of water hyacinth for biogas and biofertilizer production was studied under mesophilic conditions. It was found that water hyacinth has a low biodegradability of 27% when monodigested, while in a 3:1 ratio with cow manure, the biodegradability increases to 46%.
